Yes, this is the right way to handle it. When the app couldn't fetch the page details, it still saved my link rather than throwing my hands up and losing it — that's what matters most to me, that pasting something never just fails and drops it. And it was honest about it: a clear warning that it couldn't reach the page, a recognizable card so I still see it's saved, and the choice to either try fetching again or type in my own title and description right there.

That's much better than the alternatives I'd dread — either refusing to save at all, or silently saving a blank mystery card I'd never recognize later. Keeping the link safe, telling me plainly what happened, and letting me fix it up myself or retry is exactly what I'd want when the automatic part can't do its job. Happy with this.
